summary: Builds the career race-results page: syncs the displayed track-name global from this+0x17C, then walks the race-result linked list (head dword_7D2DC0, walk pointer dword_7D2DC8), resolving each entry's grand-prix name, formatting race number and lap time, and emitting one UI menu item per column with labels from UIListIndexedAccessor(10/11/12).

operations.description: Initialize local text buffers: v19 (256-byte row buffer) seeded from String1 (0x007CD8BC); v17/v15/v16 seeded from word_5C694C with zero-filled tails and v18 cleared.

Sync the global track name: read this+0x17C (fallback byte_5EA438) and compare with dword_7CE668 (fallback byte_5EA438); if they differ, StringCopyWithBufferRealloc updates the global track-name buffer from this object's name.
Seed the walk: dword_7D2DC8 = dword_7D2DC0 (list head); current node = *dword_7D2DC0 or null when the list is empty.
Iterate the race-result linked list until the current node is null; the first iteration runs unconditionally via the loop flag.

Resolve the grand-prix name for the node: read the node's name pointer (fallback byte_5EA438); if SeasonRacesSectionFinder succeeds, StringKeyedLinkedListSearch(aGrandprixname) -> DataEntryAccessor -> strcpy into v17, otherwise bounded copy via sub_587DD0(v17, name, 63).
Format the race number read from node+16 as "%d" into v16.
Format the lap time: read the float at node+20, compute whole minutes as CRTFtol(value) / 60, keep the fractional-seconds remainder after subtracting whole minutes, and format "%i:%06.3f" into v15.
Emit row 1: join the UIListIndexedAccessor(10) label, the word_5C692C separator and the grand-prix name v17 as "%s%s%s" into v19, then UIMenuItemCreator(v19, 0, 0, 0, 0).
Emit row 2: join the UIListIndexedAccessor(11) label, the separator and the race number v16 as "%s%s%s", then UIMenuItemCreator.
Emit row 3: join the UIListIndexedAccessor(12) label, the separator and the lap time v15 as "%s%s%s", then UIMenuItemCreator.
Emit a separator row: format v19 from byte_5EA438 (default/empty) and call UIMenuItemCreator.
Advance the walk: dword_7D2DC8 = *dword_7D2DC8+4 (next link); if nonzero, current node = *next, else current node = null.

t = node->lap_time_float; mins = ftol(t)/60; if (mins > 0) t -= 60*mins;
